verdict.rationale: stagewise's enterprise page lists "Optional self-hosting of the stagewise Cloud", and the docs describe the open-source desktop IDE as able to skip the managed service entirely by using BYOK for every provider. However, self-hosting is a single line on an enterprise tier, with no deployment documentation or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: self-hosting documentation (deployment guide, requirements), availability outside the enterprise tier, independent or hands-on confirmation of a self-hosted deployment.
